note: Questions for developing and judging the tag mapper by hand. They are deliberately NOT the frozen test questions: prompts are refined against these, then measured once on data/testset.json, so the measured numbers stay honest. Nothing here is scored automatically. 'expect' says what shape of answer is right, which is a judgement to read, not an assertion to run.

queries.question: I need a number for how walkable each suburb is.
queries.expect: Names a specific measure, so it should reach Walkability Index. Small area is reasonable for 'suburb'. No region, no access.

queries.question: What helps people be more physically active day to day?
queries.expect: Broad. Should stay at the Physical Activity focus and pick NO measure. This is the main case for stopping early.

queries.question: I want to look at whether how walkable a place is has anything to do with people developing chronic illness.
queries.expect: Rocky's walkability-and-illness example, reworded. The scan has no illness measure, so the right answer is the walkability side only, not an invented health outcome tag.

queries.question: What can I get for Brisbane without filling in an application?
queries.expect: Access Public. Brisbane is a council, so LGA is reasonable and Queensland is defensible. No measure and no health focus: the question names no subject at all.

queries.question: Is there anything on what children eat?
queries.expect: Healthy Eating focus. A measure only if one genuinely covers children's intake; otherwise stay at the focus.

queries.question: Which of these would cost us money to get hold of?
queries.expect: Fee required, and nothing else. No subject is named, so every other group should be empty.

queries.question: I am after peer-reviewed work on parks and mental health.
queries.expect: Kind of source Peer-reviewed, and two focuses: Physical Activity (parks) and Mental Wellbeing. Tests whether two focuses can be held at once.

queries.question: How do councils and health services actually share information with each other?
queries.expect: Regional partnerships focus area. No health focus, no measure. Tests a focus-area-only question.

queries.question: what data is there on hospital car parking fees?
queries.expect: Nothing in the scan covers this. No tags at all is the right answer, and the page should say the results may not be relevant.

queries.question: Counts of people cycling past a given point, ideally updated often.
queries.expect: Walking & cycling counts. 'Updated often' has no tag, so it should be ignored rather than mapped to something close.

queries.question: Show me everything you have.
queries.expect: No tags. Nothing is specified, so the search should fall back to the words and say so, rather than guessing.

queries.question: Are poorer neighbourhoods worse off for places to be active?
queries.expect: Equity and Physical Activity. An equity measure about walkability or park access would be right; a generic measure would be too narrow.
